relationship_to_game_rules: Patch strategy overrides are coaching priors only. They do not define game-rule timing, augment stages, sprite legality, base economy math, or leveling thresholds.

economy_management_overrides.patch_scope: S18.1 economy-heavy four-cost cap and high-order transformation strategy note.
economy_management_overrides.relationship_to_base: Apply Common economy, roll, leveling, HP, and interest rules first. This file only describes a conditional S18 line.

strategy_notes.label: 盗宗
when: The current board has at least two relevant four-cost units or, more importantly, meaningful copy progress toward one target four-cost three-star; arbitrary four-cost count alone is not enough.
The selected augment direction is economy-heavy or otherwise gives high resources without a proportionally high immediate combat cap.
The level-8 board can stabilize enough HP and combat strength without spending to level 9 immediately.
The current shop, copies, contest, gold, and HP support a realistic three-star four-cost search rather than a single-card fantasy.
actions: Treat level 8 as the deliberate stabilization and search state. Before the target four-cost three-star is completed, do not level 9 as part of the 盗宗 line; if leveling 9 becomes necessary for survival or a clearly better executable plan, the 盗宗 line has been exited.
Use the saved leveling budget to find the selected four-cost three-star target while preserving the Common-defined survival and economy floor.
After the target four-cost three-star is completed, reassess the remaining board, HP, gold, replacement slots, and the possible level-9 or transformation cap.

If the high-order transformation mechanic is available and no nature sprite was selected, evaluate the 0-cost-sprite interaction only after checking the current S18 descriptor and actual sprite availability; do not assume it will appear.
exit_conditions: The four-cost copies are not arriving or are heavily contested.
The level-8 board cannot hold HP without immediate quality spending.

The target copy progress collapses, the line is contested, or the level-8 board cannot survive; exit the 盗宗 line and stabilize or pivot. A pre-three-star level-9 move is an exit, not a normal 盗宗 action.
The required sprite or transformation condition is unavailable or unconfirmed.
strategy_notes.evidence_policy: This is a user-confirmed S18 strategy prior, not a game-rule assertion. Runtime must present it conditionally and let current live facts, confirmed choices, and deterministic math override it.

host_model_policy: When the S18 盗宗 conditions are met, hold level 8 for a realistic target four-cost three-star search. Do not level 9 before that three-star within the 盗宗 line; treat any forced level-9 move as an explicit exit or pivot decision, and do not treat two four-cost units alone as sufficient proof.
The high-order transformation interaction is a conditional tactical note. Verify current sprite ownership, affordability, stage availability, and the active S18 descriptor before recommending it.
If the line is losing HP or copies are contested, prioritize stabilization or pivoting over preserving the 盗宗 plan.
